name: Voltage transformer with two secondary windings
aliases: VT with metering and protection windings
summary: VT with two separate secondary windings, typically one for metering and one for protection, each with its own fusing.
description: This VT form has one primary and two secondary windings. The usual arrangement gives a metering winding with a high accuracy class and a protection winding, each fused or protected by an MCB separately so a fault on one circuit does not take out the other.

Both windings share the same core, so their combined burden must stay within the VT's thermal rating. The symbol shows the two windings but not the class of each or the secondary protection, which must be stated for each circuit.
readingNotes: Read the class and burden of each winding.
Find the separate secondary protection for each winding.
distinction: A VT with two secondaries shares one core; two separate VTs give independent cores.
